subject: Redo benchmarks with classifier in place
description: Re-run the ON/OFF bench suite now that the difficulty classifier is implemented. Previous v4/v5 numbers predate the classifier — results will look different with difficulty-gated retrieval. Target: frequency/lift result on the held-out existence proof (cold 0/10 vs warm 8.75/10) that converts to a publishable benchmark protocol including negative results.

summary: Graded all frozen artifacts for bench-metric (4 runs) and locale-sum (28 runs) that existed in bench/heldout/frozen/ but were not yet recorded in results-heldout.jsonl. Appended 32 new graded rows. Updated bench-report.js to: (1) normalize candidate→problem on input, (2) include unreadable rows in solveTally for solve-rate tracking, (3) add a "Solve rates (all candidates)" table to report.md/json. Regenerated bench/report.md and bench/report.json. Key results — locale-sum: ON=0.722 OFF=0.500 (+22pp); overlay-save: ON=0.818 OFF=0.636 (+18pp); bench-metric: ON=OFF=1.0 (parity); task-transcript: ON=0.273 OFF=0.000 (low absolute rate).
